Quick Tutorial

How to Geotag Photos Online in 5 Simple Steps

Fast, free, and completely client-side in-browser photo metadata tagger.

01

Upload Your Image

Select or drag-and-drop your JPEG, PNG, or WebP pictures. Existing EXIF coordinates are automatically detected.

02

Pin Location on Map

Click on the interactive map, drag the GPS marker, or search any city or address with the instant geocoder.

03

Add SEO Keywords & Alt Text

Input targeted local SEO keywords, business descriptions, and document titles into standard EXIF/IPTC metadata tags.

04

Write EXIF Geotags

Click "Write EXIF Tags" to inject GPS latitude, longitude, and metadata directly into the image header in your browser.

05

Download Geotagged Photo

Download the modified high-resolution JPEG immediately, or export all uploaded photos together as a single ZIP archive.
